name: The Silvercrest Pilgrimage
source:
In an era of peace and harmony, Prince Rowan Silvercrest's life takes an unexpected turn when he is kidnapped by the notorious outlaw, Blackthorn. At the mercy of an infamous bandit crew, can the Prince escape unscathed?

Yet, as strange and dangerous events unfold, Prince Rowan finds himself slowly forming a powerful connection with his captor. Lead the Prince on a treacherous path of destiny, love, and sacrifice. The fate of the world is at stake.

[B]The Silvercrest Pilgrimage[/b] is a linear romance visual novel that follows Prince Rowan and his adventures with Roderick, the [i]Blackthorn[/i]. The story follows a set path focused around the central romance between the two main characters.

[From [url=https://orangelo.itch.io/the-silvercrest-pilgrimage]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一片和平安宁的年代里，罗文·西尔弗克雷斯特王子遭恶名昭彰的法外狂徒“黑棘”绑架，平静的人生由此突生变故。落入这伙臭名远扬的强盗手中，王子能否毫发无伤地逃出生天？

然而，随着一桩桩诡谲而凶险的事件接连上演，罗文王子却发现自己与绑架者之间正悄然滋生出一股深厚的羁绊。引领王子踏上这条交织着宿命、爱恋与牺牲的险途吧——整个世界的命运正悬于一线。

[b]《The Silvercrest Pilgrimage》[/b]是一部线性叙事的恋爱视觉小说，讲述罗文王子与[i]“黑棘”[/i]罗德里克并肩冒险的旅程。故事沿着既定主线推进，围绕两位主角之间的核心恋情徐徐展开。

[摘自[url=https://orangelo.itch.io/the-silvercrest-pilgrimage]itch.io[/url]]
